method.fetch: All refs/heads/* and refs/pull/*/head fetched before implementation. API metadata covers complete branch lists and all pull requests (both states, all pages).
method.exact_tree_equivalence: For non-ancestor heads, compare git rev-parse <SHA>^{tree} with every actual baseline ancestor tree. Equality includes full tracked contents, paths, and modes.
method.scope: Branch and PR source snapshot at the recorded cutoff; later concurrent activity is outside this initial audit.
method.ci: No GitHub Actions or check/status endpoints queried, polled, awaited or rerun.
